notes.text: Sample note — replace me in pack.json. Click the charm for the next one.
You reviewed my first PR with forty comments and zero condescension. I still write code for that reviewer.
Every system that didn't fall over this year is a love letter from you.
Travel far, settle soft. The pipelines will hold. Probably.
Honest in the postmortem, kind in the hallway. Rare combination.
You taught me that 'I don't know yet' is a complete sentence.
Wherever you land, they're getting the best mentor we ever had.
